Subject: Onboarding runbook and evidence curation for Arden Health - OneTrust scope

Hi Samantha —

Great to meet you last week. We're ready to kick off the OneTrust profile onboarding for Arden Health and I wanted to share a short runbook that outlines the minimal evidence set we typically need to get a profile into a reviewable state. This is deliberately scoped for a first pass so you can be live in the portal within 7–10 business days.

Quick asks to start (can reply in-line):
- Confirm whether you want the SOC 2 scope to include customer-facing services only or infra-level controls as well.
- Provide a link to where you store system diagrams/network boundaries (S3/Confluence/Drive).
- Point us to a current CAIQ/SIG if you have one; if not we can start from our mapped template.

I attached a 1-page runbook (redwood_onetrust-mini-onboard-runbook-v1.pdf) and a proposed CAIQ mapping spreadsheet to speed alignment.

If helpful, propose a 30-minute sync tomorrow 11/11 10:00–10:30 PT to walk through the checklist and owners. Ben will help with evidence ingestion and Marcus will own the SCIM/SSO questions.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—Laura Bennett
Laura Bennett
Senior Trust & Onboarding Manager

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the runbook and the spreadsheet, very helpful. Quick answers below:
- SOC 2 scope: please include both customer-facing services and the data ingestion pipeline (we want the SOC 2 report to cover the full customer data flow).
- System diagrams: internal Drive link: https://drive.ardenhealth.com/s/infra/network-diagrams (Tom will share access).
- CAIQ: we have an internal CAIQ export from last year (attached) but it hasn't been updated for a few controls.

Attachments: Arden_CAiq_2025_export.json (we'll upload the raw next-steps export to the Drive folder).

Tom and I can join the 11/11 10:00 PT call. Can you also add a short column in your spreadsheet for control evidence TTL/rotation? We have a lot of temporary creds that change frequently so we want to track cadence.

Best,
Samantha
